Day 6 of the giant Amazon Black Friday sale is now underway and the latest AirPods Pro 3 are live again at a wild $100 off the list price! While that’s quite possibly the best Apple deal you’ll see all year, Amazon is now delivering the very best price on the single AirTag 2 at just $18 Prime shipped, the best price of the year on iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) at $49, and even the Apple Polishing Cloth is back in stock at $9 Prime shipped.

As for the big ticket Apple gear, the brand new M6 Mac Book Pro has dropped again to its best price ever at $220 off, we will have some banger $300 price drops on M5 MacBook Air, and some wonderful iPad deals – the new OLED iPad mini at $100 off and this M5 iPad Pro at $350 off(one of the lowest prices ever). All of that joins all-time lows on Apple Watch Series 12 at $100 off and SE 3 at just $179, plus loads more below.

Go, go, go! AirPods Pro 3 are now live again at a wild $100 off for Black Friday

Okay folks we are back with the latest AirPods Pro 3 live again at a wild $100 off the list price! There’s no telling how long this incredible deal will last, as it went out of stock quite quickly yesterday, but it is now live again…get in there quick.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – $100 off, All-time low

After dropping to $179 to start the Black Friday bonanza, the price plummeted again at $100 off to deliver the very best deal we have tracked.

Regularly $249, this is a straight up $100 off the world’s greatest earbuds and it is now live again.

Needless to say, this is easily one of the very best Black Friday deals we have tracked yet, and I’m not sure anything is going to beat it later this week.

Amazon 2026 Black Friday Week – Day 6: Save hundreds on Apple, Google, Samsung, Bose, Anker, more

Land a single AirTag 2 at the lowest price ever for Black Friday: $18 Prime shipped (Nearly 40% off)

Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 just hit the lowest price ever at $18 via Amazon.

Just when you thought the ground-breaking, next-generation 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth was the only super affordable official Apple gear you can score for Black Friday, Amazon has now dropped AirTag 2 down to a new all-time low at $18 Prime shipped.

While we are still waiting that 4-pack deal back down at $70, if you don’t four of them you can now score a single AirTag 2 for just $18 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35.

Regularly $29 for one of them, this is actually major discount at just shy of 40% off the list price and the best deal we have ever tracked.

M5 MacBook Air models currently at $300 off for Black Friday – best prices in nearly 6 months

We are moving into Day 6 and, while yesterday was a wild one with some deals now temporarily jumping up in price a little bit, Apple’s 1TB M5 MacBook Air is sitting at a particularly fantastic $300 off right now.

Amazon is now offering a couple configurations of Apple’s latest M5 MacBook Air at a seriously notable $300 off, with the 13-inch model with 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage at $1,299 shipped.

This is a $1,599 configuration, and you’ll now find all four colors at a straight up $300 off the list.

We did catch the base model at $310 off yesterday, but that deal has jump up $60 – we will keep a close eye on that listing.

Also very much of note for folks interested in the larger model: Amazon is also offering the most affordable 15-inch model down at $1,199 shipped from the regular $1,499 list price for the same $300 in savings and the best deal in nearly 6 months.

That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If you’re looking to setup a powerful workstation or upgrade your existing rig, the 26-port FusionDock Ultra is specifically designed to elevate demanding Apple Silicon Mac workstations with support for up to four native 6K displays, 140W charging, 10Gb Ethernet, and a combination of dual-chip architecture and active cooling for stable, dependable performance – scope out our hands-on review for a closer look. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.
